people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Mizpah
people.line: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment

translations.web: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpah, saying, “None of us will give his daughter to Benjamin as a wife.”
translations.bsb: Now the men of Israel had sworn an oath at Mizpah, saying, “Not one of us will give his daughter in marriage to a Benjamite.”
translations.kjv: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpeh, saying, There shall not any of us give his daughter unto Benjamin to wife.
translations.asv: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpah, saying, There shall not any of us give his daughter unto Benjamin to wife.
